contracts: One actual owner per desktop/host build, constructed before main/SDL; entry-only access to its namespaced value.
Owned calls receive APPSESSION references; fixed-signature callbacks bind their target owner.
APPSESSION::lpui is a fixed non-owning pointer to the derived UI owner value, never a second UI state.
Game/UI reset keeps field addresses; close order and callback cleanup/error delivery remain unchanged.
QSORTCOMPARE retains the foreign bsearch ABI; APPQSORTCOMPARE carries the owned sort context without changing sorting operations.
Header/disk field widths and original debug names remain unchanged; TILEDRAWPROC adds an owner argument but retains native pointer storage.

archived_observer_projection.purpose: The retained C native hook keeps its ABI and observation identifiers. Its C++ projection binds real fields locally at the fixed timer entry; OBSERVER_OWNER_ARG supplies explicit arity only for current owned calls. No global alias or application C interface is introduced.
